description:
Find passages in open-access full-text papers that answer a question, by meaning as well as keywords (e.g. 'what
limits grain filling under heat stress', 'genes controlling spike architecture'). Combines vector search
(BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings) and keyword search, ranked by reciprocal rank fusion. Each passage gives the
paper (title, year, DOI, PMCID, licence) and section. Quote passages verbatim and cite the paper; summarise rather
than reword quotes from no-derivatives (ND) papers. Covers only open-access papers in PubMed Central; methods
sections are not indexed.
name: search_papers
